name: Murasawa Itsuki
source:
Her parents died in a car accident, and she was raised by her grandparents. Not wanting her to cause any trouble, her grandparents enrolles her in an all-girls boarding school.

Her mind has trouble processing the trauma of losing her parents-- Itsuki, formerly an ordinary girl, has shut off her heart completely and tries her best to avoid any sort of relationship with others. In her new school, she always spends her time alone and doesn't make any friends, and her classmates don't seem to want to have much to do with her either.

Her hobby is reading, and her grades are a little bit above average.
